title: Maximal Algebraic Ideals in Nonunital $C^*$-Algebras
summary: Motivated by Ozawa's question of whether every maximal algebraic two-sided ideal in a \(C^*\)-algebra must be closed, we study the existence of maximal algebraic two-sided ideals in nonunital \(C^*\)-algebras. We formulate singular-distribution estimates intrinsically in terms of lower semicontinuous \(2\)-quasitraces and develop a novel criterion, called a compact quasitracial comparison pair. These are used to control membership in algebraic ideals and to establish the nonexistence of maximal ideals in nonunital \(C^*\)-algebras under a closed finite-scale face condition.
